question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Ludicrous
solution:
The correct answer is **'Crazy'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ludicrous**__**: Very silly; ridiculous (बहुत बेतुका; हास्‍यास्‍पद)**

 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- What a **ludicrous** idea!
 
 
 
• __**Crazy**__**: V****ery silly or foolish (सनकी, पागल, मूर्ख)**
 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- You must be **crazy** to turn down such a wonderful offer.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **'Crazy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Intuitive**__**: Perceiving directly by intuition without rational thought, as a person or the mind.**

 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- A positive pregnancy test soon confirmed her **intuitive** feelings.
 
 
 
• __**Astute**__**: Very clever; good at judging people or situations (चतुर व होशियार, व्‍यक्तियों या स्थितियों को परखने में कुशल​)**
 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- She was politically **astute.**
 
 
 
• **​__Intrinsic__: Belonging to something as part of its nature; basic [(किसी वस्‍तु की) प्रकृति का अंतरंग,मूलभूत]**
 __
 
• **​E.g.__**- The object is of no **intrinsic **value.
